## Preset request

**Proposed domain:** <e.g. health / agriculture / music / ...>

**Proposed preset ID:** <e.g. `maritime-fishing`>

### What this would cover

<What terminology should this preset contain? Roughly how many entries? Who would use it?>

### Why it's needed

<What problem does its absence cause? Specific translation work you're doing? Gap in the existing catalog?>

### Available sources

<Do you know of references that could seed the preset? Government publications, expert communities, existing glossaries? List them here.>

### Can you author it?

- [ ] Yes — I'm volunteering to author this preset
- [ ] Partially — I can contribute entries but need help with curation or review
- [ ] No — I'm requesting that someone else create it

(All three are valid! Many useful presets start as requests that someone else picks up later.)
